runtime_scope: wall-clock time from the first training epoch through validation, checkpoint loading, 51-condition/draw final test passes, and prediction-file writing; excludes initial data loading/model construction; legacy raw key 'training_seconds' is not pure training time. selected_core_total includes both candidate stages regardless of selected stage.
comparison_policy: PIDS-CCF selected core versus clean CCF is primary. The scene router is a prespecified secondary extension and cannot replace the core merely because routing happens to improve final test results.
